programs.title: Karishma
programs.desc: A photographer joins up with a group of supermodels, who are sent abroad by a businessman. However, all is not as it seems as other models in similar situations keep showing up dead under suspicious circumstances.

programs.title: Loha
programs.desc: After a bid to arrest Sher Singh fails, officer Dayal is crippled and his partner Amar's career is sabotaged. When Amar gets another chance to nab Sher Singh, he hires two crooks for the job.
